sloka: निहतस्य मया संख्ये शर संकृत्त मर्मणः ।सफेनम् रुधिरम् कस्य मेदिनी पातुम् इच्छसि ॥३-१९-९॥
transliteration: nihatasya mayā saṁkhye śara saṁkṛtta marmaṇaḥ ।saphenam rudhiram kasya medinī pātum icchasi ॥3-19-9॥

translations.english: Whose foamy, red blood will the earth drink while I strike his vital organs with my arrows in the fight ?
